name: Greyscale Dye Set
description:
In a world full of Color, sometimes we find the most Harmony in the simplest of things...



This highly exclusive set of Greyscale Dyes for Dollys is a reward for all holders of Hunnys Relics, a special set of Hunnys that range from Token ID #1 thru #150.



Owning this unlocks the following set of Hunnys Closet Dyes (for use on all Hunnys Closet items):



Dye: Grey 1

Dye: Grey 2

Dye: Grey 3

Dye: Grey 4

Dye: Grey 5

Dye: White



All pieces purchased within this Hunnys Closet Shop collection will immediately unlock the specified item(s) for use in the [Hunnys Closet](https://closet.hunnys.io).


As long as you currently hold this token in the same wallet that you are connected with when using the [Hunnys Closet](https://closet.hunnys.io), it will automatically be available for use - enjoy!
